line: Send a voice message instead of a text — let them hear you smile.
paragraph: Emma Kessler woke anxious on race morning. She was twenty-two and had never run thirteen miles. Her boyfriend's running shoes sat in the trunk. She did not know he had trained for two months. At the start line, he laced up beside her. She heard his smile before she saw it.
